author: Bảo
questions: How many posts did {firstName} {lastName} create in {year}?
How many posts did {firstName} {lastName} publish during {year}?
What is the number of posts written by {firstName} {lastName} in {year}?
gold: MATCH (:Person {firstName: $firstName, lastName: $lastName})<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(p:Post) WHERE p.creationDate.year = $year RETURN count(DISTINCT p)
candidates: MATCH (p:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(x:Person) WITH x, p.creationDate.year AS year, count(*) AS k RETURN x.firstName AS firstName, x.lastName AS lastName, year ORDER BY lastName, firstName, year
note: Năm theo UTC của creationDate. Chỉ Post, không gồm Comment.

author: Bảo
questions: How many people joined the network in {monthName} {year}?
How many accounts were created in {monthName} {year}?
What is the number of people who signed up in {monthName} {year}?
gold: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.creationDate.year = $year AND p.creationDate.month = $month RETURN count(p)
candidates: MATCH (p:Person) WITH DISTINCT p.creationDate.year AS year, p.creationDate.month AS month RETURN year, month, ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'][month - 1] AS monthName ORDER BY year, month
note: Tháng/năm theo UTC của Person.creationDate (ngày tạo tài khoản). monthName chỉ để hiển thị.

author: Bảo
questions: What was the first forum that {firstName} {lastName} became a member of?
Which forum has {firstName} {lastName} been a member of the longest?
gold: MATCH (f:Forum)-[m:HAS_MEMBER]->(:Person {firstName: $firstName, lastName: $lastName}) RETURN f.title ORDER BY m.joinDate LIMIT 1
check: MATCH (f:Forum)-[m:HAS_MEMBER]->(:Person {firstName: $firstName, lastName: $lastName}) WITH m.joinDate AS d ORDER BY d LIMIT 2 WITH collect(d) AS top RETURN size(top) = 2 AND top[0] < top[1]
candidates: MATCH (p:Person) WITH p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, collect(p) AS ps WHERE size(ps) = 1 WITH firstName, lastName, ps[0] AS p WHERE COUNT { (:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p) } >= 2 RETURN firstName, lastName ORDER BY lastName, firstName
note: Sắp theo thuộc tính thời gian trên cạnh (HAS_MEMBER.joinDate). check: ít nhất 2 forum và không trùng thời điểm.

author: Bảo
questions: How many comments did {firstName} {lastName} write in the {quarterName} quarter of {year}?
In the {quarterName} quarter of {year}, how many comments did {firstName} {lastName} make?
What is the number of comments {firstName} {lastName} wrote during Q{quarter} {year}?
gold: MATCH (:Person {firstName: $firstName, lastName: $lastName})<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(c:Comment) WHERE c.creationDate.year = $year AND c.creationDate.quarter = $quarter RETURN count(DISTINCT c)
candidates: MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(x:Person) WITH x, c.creationDate.year AS year, c.creationDate.quarter AS quarter, count(*) AS k RETURN x.firstName AS firstName, x.lastName AS lastName, year, quarter, ['first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth'][quarter - 1] AS quarterName ORDER BY lastName, firstName, year, quarter
note: Khoảng thời gian theo quý (Q1 = tháng 1–3, UTC). Chỉ Comment.

author: Bảo
questions: Who did {firstName} {lastName} become friends with in {year}?
Which people became friends with {firstName} {lastName} during {year}?
List the new friends {firstName} {lastName} made in {year}.
gold: MATCH (:Person {firstName: $firstName, lastName: $lastName})-[k:KNOWS]-(f:Person) WHERE k.creationDate.year = $year RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName
candidates: MATCH (x:Person)-[k:KNOWS]-() WITH x, k.creationDate.year AS year, count(*) AS c WHERE c <= 20 RETURN x.firstName AS firstName, x.lastName AS lastName, year ORDER BY lastName, firstName, year
note: Năm theo UTC của KNOWS.creationDate (thời điểm kết bạn), KNOWS không chiều. Đáp án dạng danh sách.
